wagon.intro: Nine iron-bound chests stand in a half circle under an awning. Among them sits a gray-haired woman, sorting cards by lamplight.
wagon.wants: "Ysolt, of the Nine Chests," she says without looking up. "Eight are full. The ninth wants three brass birds. Ornithopters. I pay 150 gold for each, and I do not haggle."
wagon.have: She looks up sharply. "You have one. I can hear its wings ticking in your bag."
wagon.count: Brass birds in the ninth chest so far: {count}.
wagon.traded: Ysolt takes {card} in both hands, winds it once to hear it tick, and lays it in the ninth chest. She counts out 150 gold.
wagon.spent: The ninth chest is shut and locked. "Thirty years," Ysolt says. "Now I will have to think of a tenth."
wagon.gift_done: She opens the first chest, the oldest, and takes out a blue amulet wrapped in oilcloth, and bread for four days. "For the road. You carried my birds; let these carry you."
